Class CPU_Msg

java.lang.Object
app.model.CPU_Msg
public class CPU_Msg extends Object
The CPU_Msg class provides a collection of predefined messages for CPU interactions in a game, supporting both English and Korean languages. These messages include greetings, notifications about game states, and responses to chat inputs.
